## `policies list`

Retrieve list of Policies with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli policies list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/Policies` · Response: `PolicyListItemModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--name` | string |  | The Name of the Policy, e.g. - Policy1 |
| `--size` | integer |  | The Size of the Policy in Kb, e.g. 225 |
| `--revision` | integer |  | The number of revisions for the Policy, e.g. 5 |
| `--total-assigned-revisions` | integer |  | The total number of Groups with the Policy assigned (any Revision), e.g. 10 |
| `--created-dates` | list of date-time |  | Valid date formats for filter - 2020-12-24, 2020-12-24 19:09:47, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562, 2020-12-24 19:09:47.6816562 +00:00 |
| `--created-selection-mode` | string | `Single`, `Multiple`, `Range` | The selection mode of date criteria e.g single, multiple, range |
| `--draft-user` | string |  | The 'Locked By' user, i.e. the user that created the last draft which has locked the Policy, e.g. jbloggs@email.com |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli policies list --all -o json
```

## `policies create`

Creates new policy with provided file

```
epm-cli policies create [flags]
```

API: `POST /v3/Policies`

**Request body** (form with file upload)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `Name` | string |  | Policy Name |
| `--description` | `Description` | string |  | Policy Description |
| `--policy-file` | `PolicyFile` | file path |  | Policy Content File |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli policies create --policy-file ./file
```

## `policies update`

Request to update policy properties

```
epm-cli policies update <ID> [flags]
```

API: `PUT /v3/Policies/{id}`

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | PolicyId |

**Request body** (JSON, `ModifyPolicyRequest`)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | `name` | string |  | – |
| `--description` | `description` | string |  | – |

Other or nested fields: `--set path=value`, or pass the whole body with `--body` (inline, `@file.json` or `-` for stdin). Example body (`--body-template`):

```json
{
  "name": "",
  "description": ""
}
```

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli policies update <ID> --name <VALUE>
```

## `policies delete`

Deletes policy

> **Destructive:** asks for confirmation before it runs; scripts must pass `--yes`. Preview with `--dry-run` first.

```

```

API: `DELETE /v3/Policies/{id}`

**Arguments**

|---|---|
| `<ID>` | id |

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force-delete` | switch |  | `forceDelete` |

**Example**

```sh

```

## `policies upload`

Upload New Policy Revision

```

```

API: `POST /v3/Policies/{id}/Upload`

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | Policy Id |

**Request body** (form with file upload)

| Flag | Field | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--policy-file` | `PolicyFile` | file path |  | Policy Content File |
| `--auto-assign-to-group` | `AutoAssignToGroup` | switch |  | Auto Assign Policy Revision to Computer Groups |

**Example**

```sh

```
